patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content sections alternate image and text placement (image left, text right; then text left, image right) to break visual monotony while maintaining a clear reading flow.
Headings use a very large, bold sans-serif font for impact, contrasting with a lighter weight, highly legible sans-serif for body text, maintaining a consistent modern feel.
A clean, high-contrast palette relies heavily on white backgrounds and dark text, punctuated by a vibrant, fresh green used strategically for calls to action and key accents.
Content blocks and images slide into view from the left or right as the user scrolls down the page, creating a dynamic reveal effect for each section.
A dedicated 'Proof' section uses small, distinct badges to convey trust and social validation immediately below the hero, before diving into detailed features.

technique_notes: Uses a scroll-triggered animation library (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger or Locomotive Scroll) to orchestrate elements sliding into view from the sides (left or right) as their parent sections become visible. This creates a staggered reveal effect for images and text blocks, enhancing engagement. The hero section features an auto-playing video.
Employs a full-width video hero with a subtle overlay and centered text to immediately convey the site's message and create an immersive first impression.
Interactive FAQ section utilizes accordions to present information concisely, expanding on click to reveal answers without cluttering the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, uppercase labels for section introductions.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — buttons and image containers feature slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks create a clean, uncrowded feel.

standout: This site stands out with its confident, direct messaging paired with a clean, spacious layout and subtle scroll-triggered animations. The consistent use of a vibrant green accent against a largely white canvas creates a fresh, trustworthy, and highly legible experience, making complex financial topics feel approachable.
